channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jerry Reinsdorf | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jerry Reinsdorf from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: BJ Armstrong on Jerry Reinsdorf
item.description:
Armstrong said of negotiating with the Bulls.

“I consider Jerry (Reinsdorf) a mentor. And I consider John a friend. I’ve known John for almost 30 years.”

BJ Armstrong on Jerry Reinsdorf, Apr 14, 2018. Source: Chicago Tribune.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Jerry Reinsdorf
item.description:
KC Johnson:Tom Thibodeau:

“Jerry (Reinsdorf) was great to me. I've got great respect for him. At some point, I'll sit down with Jerry.”

Tom Thibodeau on Jerry Reinsdorf, Dec 13, 2016. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Jerry Reinsdorf
item.description:
KC Johnson:Shaq on Reinsdorf:

“I knew he wasn't a micromanager. In order to tolerate Rodman, you have to be able to say, 'Phil, you do what you do.'”

Shaquille O'Neal on Jerry Reinsdorf, Sep 8, 2016. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Jerry Reinsdorf
item.description:
KC Johnson:Thibodeau on Bulls:

“The majority of my experience there was positive. Jerry (Reinsdorf) took a chance on me. I'll always appreciate that.”

Tom Thibodeau on Jerry Reinsdorf, Apr 26, 2016. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Jerry Reinsdorf
item.description:
coach Tom Thibodeau said.

“He heeded (Chairman Jerry Reinsdorf's) advice from the beginning to not rush it and make sure he's completely comfortable before getting out there. It's too important a decision for him to rush. Until he's completely comfortable, we don't want him out there. We knew this was a possibility and that's fine. You deal with it as best you can. We just want him to continue to work like he has been working. We want him completely healthy.”

Tom Thibodeau on Jerry Reinsdorf, May 16, 2013. Source: Chicago Tribune.
